answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can trade, like a marble dropped into a shared jar: the stake returns only after peers attest the work was real. New identities start at the bottom of a reputation ridge and may take only tiny jobs until verified attestations lift them. One whisper of fraud from a verified peer freezes the stake and triggers review, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes while earning nothing, and honest agents keep climbing.
